concern_summary: This concern encapsulates the functionalities of the Money Request Header, which manages the display of transaction statuses and user interactions for handling money requests.
This concern relates to the Money Report Header, which is responsible for rendering status messages and guiding users through the financial reporting process.
This concern focuses on the Payment Card Currency Header, conveying information about billing currency to enhance user comprehension.
This concern involves managing the state of screen share requests in the waypoint screen, ensuring that previous requests are cleared before new ones are initiated.
This concern addresses the functionality to toggle the visibility of the header navigation menu based on user interaction.
This concern relates to loading indicators within screens, managing the display logic based on the status of data retrieval and ensuring a smooth user experience during loading states.
This concern involves managing the state of screen transitions, ensuring that transitions are completed properly, which triggers updates to the UI and can impact loading states.

This concern addresses the management of screen states in navigation, including handling transitions, maintaining the correct visibility of screens based on user interaction, and ensuring accurate navigation paths.
